versions.changelog: Simpler story-first dashboard, grouped corroborating signals, and concise action plan.
Simpler story-first dashboard, grouped corroborating signals, and concise action plan.
Add a creator-private Confluence operational relay for local Splunk and SignalFx findings, with expiry, redaction, and explicit fallback coverage.

Report live connector state precisely: not registered, failed, or runtime unavailable; keep JSM alert history separate from direct Splunk and SignalFx telemetry; include complete connector-auth guidance.
Add versioned connector preflight, force dashboard refresh after updates, use delegated Rovo Slack search, prefer Ops Sherpa Splunk, and separate SignalFx alert history from live metrics.
Add secure Slack, Splunk SLAuth/MFA, and SignalFx token-expiry recovery; keep alert and live-metric coverage separate.
Refresh operational guidance and team-install documentation.

Initial release providing a technical daily brief for engineers focused on service and system health.

- Delivers a morning brief covering service health, deploys, alerts, DLQ/latency, workflows, migrations, and customer signals.
- Explicitly excludes personal work items such as ticket triage and day planning.
- Requires user confirmation of service scope via delegated auth and avoids hardcoded service/team names.
- Outlines robust error-handling and schema verification to ensure accurate reporting.
- Guides on correct use cases and access methods, including clear procedures to add or update the set of monitored services.
